kjv: how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour
mine: how to control his own body in holiness and honor
note: to heautou skeuos ktasthai may mean "control his own body" or "acquire a wife" (cf. 1 Pet 3:7 "weaker vessel"); the KJV keeps the literal "vessel" and so the ambiguity.

kjv: shall not prevent them which are asleep
mine: will not precede those who have fallen asleep
note: Prevent in 1611 meant "go before"; now it means "stop".
